description: CALL to investigate behavior in public source: supply question and relevant path_hints found from actual usages, for up to four files with commit-pinned line citations. checked_sha selects a commit; base_sha adds before/after excerpts; pr selects a public PR and observes its head's GitHub check runs. source_ranges retrieves missing context at pinned revisions, up to 40 lines per range. Selection is bounded, not exhaustive or proof of compatibility. Without question, returns the cached repository decision brief. Pass exactly one of repo or package. Example: {repo:'expressjs/multer',question:'How are file size limits handled?',path_hints:['lib/make-middleware.js']}.

base_sha.description: Compare source at this base commit; omit when using pr.

checked_sha.description: Immutable head revision; required with source_ranges.

owner.description: Repository owner, when repo carries only the bare name. Optional: prefer the single owner/repo form in repo.

package.description: npm package name, for example lodash or npm:@scope/pkg. To judge a specific VERSION rather than the package as a whole, use evaluate_dependency_change instead.

path_hints.description: Scope retrieval to these repository-relative files or directories. Requires question.

pr.description: Public PR number in repo. Requires question. Omit base_sha.

repo.description: Public GitHub repository as owner/repo or a github.com URL.

source_ranges.description: Read only these exact ranges, at most two per file/side and 40 lines per range. Requires question and checked_sha; base side also requires base_sha. Paths must fall within path_hints when supplied. Omit pr for base ranges.

end_line.description: Last line, inclusive; from start_line through start_line + 39.

name: analyze_repo
title: Inspect repository source evidence or get a decision brief
